title: Remove PDF Pages – Delete Pages Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Delete pages from a PDF in your browser: click the thumbnails of the pages to remove and download the rest, in order. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Remove pages from a PDF
subtitle: Click the pages you don't want and download the PDF without them; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Remove pages from a PDF online for free: every page appears as a thumbnail, you click the ones to delete, and you download the PDF without them. Nothing is uploaded, the remaining pages keep their order and quality, and your original file stays as it was.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Click to remove
features.text: Every page is a thumbnail: click the ones to delete, or Shift+click to mark a run of pages.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How to delete pages from a PDF

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page. Its pages appear as thumbnails.

steps.title: Mark the pages to remove
steps.text: Click each page you don't want; it is crossed out. Click again to keep it.

steps.title: Remove and download
steps.text: Click Remove pages, check the preview and download the new PDF.

handles: Picking pages: click a thumbnail to mark it, Shift+click to mark a run, or Select all.
Safety: a PDF must keep at least one page, so removing every page is refused.
Quality: the pages you keep are copied unchanged.
Next: pass the result to Organize, Rotate or Merge without downloading it first.
limits: At least one page must stay in the PDF.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be changed; remove the password first.
Bookmarks that point to removed pages may stop working.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Is the original PDF changed?
faq.answer: No. You download a new PDF; the file on your device stays as it was.

faq.question: Can I remove many pages at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Shift+click marks every page between the last one you clicked and this one, and Select all marks them all.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
